name: Sam Feng
source:
Sam was born as part of a top-secret genetically engineered assassin program at a mysterious facility called "The Workshop." It was destroyed by Lexica and her Judgement League, and he became her sidekick for a while. But that was a long time ago.

[From in-game character profile]
